sources.author: Sportsnet Unlimited
patch_list: Custom bottom tabs
Chooses which tabs the bottom bar shows, their order, and the tab the app opens on.
Custom skip intervals
Sets separate fast forward and rewind times for the Sportsnet+ player's skip buttons.
Disable game alerts
Turns off game alerts, live score notifications and Airship's pop-up messages and tracking, and stops the app from asking to send notifications.
Disable tracking
Stops Adobe, Comscore, New Relic, Chartbeat, Firebase, Conviva and Youbora from collecting and sending data about you and what you watch.
Hide ads
Removes banner, in-feed and launch ads, and the ads in highlight videos. Ads inside Sportsnet+ streams are part of the stream and are not removed.
Hide leagues
Keeps the Scores and Watch tabs to the leagues you follow.
Hide Listen button
Removes the Listen (radio and podcasts) button from the top of Home, Scores and Leagues.
Save watch position often
Saves how far you got in a Sportsnet+ replay while you watch and after you skip, not only when you pause or close it, so the place is kept if the app is closed or killed.
Stay on Scores when watching
Opens games tapped on Scores on top of Scores, so going back from the video returns to Scores instead of the Watch tab.
Video quality
Sets the quality the Sportsnet+ player starts at and stays within, and shows the player's hidden HDR setting.
Watch from Scores
Shows a watch button on every Scores game: Watch Live while a game is on, Watch Full Game once it is over. Games you cannot watch show a lock and the reason.
Watch tab opens on a league
Adds a league page as the first Watch sub-tab, so the Watch tab opens on it.
